notes.title: Dungeon Renovators Playtest #3 Now Live!
notes.content:
[h1]Dungeon Renovators Playtest #3 Notes[/h1]
Welcome to Playtest #3! There are a few fundamental changes to this build as well as the usual bugfixes, tweaks, improvements, and cult classic requests.


[olist]
[*] The hero now walks and runs faster but running requires [LSHIFT] or (X) on a xbox-style controller.
[*] There is now a storage station for mid/upper-tier wood products
[*] Rats and cold do half the damage they used to.
[*] You'll see a new poster in the Metro that reveals the next Boss fight
[*] Power attacks, running, and dodge/roll use up Stamina. 
[/olist]

In Playtest #4, we're hoping to have an expanded tutorial/intro area and a new boss fight...
